attr.title: Gunslugs
attr.desc: Run, jump and shoot through chaotic pixel-art battlefields, smash scenery and rescue characters in this action platformer by Orangepixel.
attr.inst: Place your legally obtained PC gunslugs.dat (GOG 3.3.0) or Gunslugs 3.2.4 APK in <ports directory>/gunslugs/gamedata/. The port prepares game data on first launch; PC data takes priority when both are present. See README.md for GOG and Epic download instructions.
